# Prompt
Rank the eight targets from lowest to highest human albumin SPR KD at pH6.

All molecules are the VHH-Fc constructs listed in Table9; sequence1 contains the complete tested fusion chain. Molecular names have been anonymized. The source neutral pH7.4 label is displayed as pH7.5 under the benchmark convention; acid pH6 is unchanged. 

Use only the supplied CSV. Do not browse, execute code or call external tools. Return only one comma-separated line containing all eight target names exactly once, without explanations.
